_comment: Single source of truth for the publication's brand. Change the name here; build.mjs, check.mjs, the web app (web/scripts/sync-assets.mjs) and every {{token}} in content/ read from this file.
name: PlenaryWire
tagline: Politics and policy, US and EU.
_aiDisclosure: Optional disclosure line. Empty = hidden everywhere. When set, it is shown as a note at the top of every article and in the footer.
_legal: siteUrl, contactEmail, legalEffectiveDate, governingLaw, controllerName, mailboxProvider, complaintOwner: fill before public launch. Empty contactEmail shows coming soon. Empty governingLaw/controller/mailbox/complaintOwner omit those clauses.
